metadata.book2_library_note: The uploaded ZIP contains Bookster_IAP_Local_Client_Library_v1.xlsx and bookster_avatar_pool_AUDITED.xlsx. The local library is Book0/current-state based and contains no BOOK2 references, so Book2 creative cells were added by mapping filename/ad-name and visual deconstruction.

core_reanalysis_read.primary_control_read: C4E's aspirational authority/static system is the checkout-depth control. It generated the clear majority of onb_initiate_checkout volume.
core_reanalysis_read.registration_control_read: C2B's product-demo/time-saving creative is the registration control, especially among female 45-54, but it failed to carry checkout depth in V3.
core_reanalysis_read.data_caveat: Demographic export is reliable for completed registrations, but V3 checkout results were not populated by age/gender. Demographic checkout claims must remain directional based on spend/click quality, not result counts.
